title: aidd stack list --json
description: aidd's library of stacks: opinionated standards that go together, plus the `[project.stack]` entries they bring. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

description.description: What the stack is for, in one sentence.

extends.description: The stack it builds on, or null.

standards.description: Its standards, by id, the base stack's included.

allowed.description: False when the company's `[standards_policy] allow_stacks` leaves it out.
